entries.name: Trout daily quota
entries.scope_note: The chapter header reads '(excluding Haida Gwaii)'. No excludes operator: Haida Gwaii's own MU-group quotas sit at a finer tier and replace these, rendering them struck beside.
entries.regs_verbatim: Region 1 Daily Quotas (excluding Haida Gwaii). Trout: 4, but not more than 1 over 50 cm (2 hatchery steelhead over 50 cm allowed, see table for exceptions), 2 from streams (must be hatchery). And you must release: All wild steelhead, All wild trout from streams, All char (includes Dolly Varden). NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes or hatchery origin trout in streams.

NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes or hatchery origin trout in streams.
